name: Hashed 3D Representations
definition: Hybrid 3D representations that combine hashed structures (such as voxel grids and triplanes) with MLPs. They are used as the underlying structure for Lightplane components because they are fast, relatively memory efficient, and familiar to practitioners.
summary: Hashed 3D Representations decompose neural fields into a hashing scheme and small MLP, using sparse structures like triplanes to solve memory bottlenecks while decoupling spatial indexing from the network.
